title: NeoPixel Loop Pixel Stepper
description: Step a for loop over a 30-pixel strip one iteration at a time, and watch an off-by-one error leave the first pixel dark.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Chapter 19: Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, and the Moving Rainbow Kit

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a for loop iterating over a NeoPixel strip's pixel indices, the learner demonstrates which physical pixel changes color on each pass through the loop.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Step-through of a for loop with the executing line highlighted and an off-by-one toggle
pedagogical.assessment: Ask how many values range(0, 30) yields and what the largest is.
